subject.title: fix(sessions): migrate session naming to canonical title

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `title` as the canonical persisted and RPC-facing user-editable session name while mirroring legacy `label`, and refresh this PR onto current main to do that?
rationale: The code shape is coherent, but choosing `title` as canonical changes durable session metadata, protocol parameters, generated models, and compatibility expectations; automation should not make that API/product contract decision.

options.title: Adopt title and refresh
options.body: Keep this PR open, resolve the current main conflicts, preserve `label` as the compatibility mirror, and require focused session/protocol/UI proof before merge.

options.title: Keep label canonical
options.body: Close or replace this with a narrower label-only repair, leaving `title` out of the stable session API for now.

options.title: Split the migration
options.body: Land only the clear/null bug fixes first and track canonical `title` as a separate API migration.

recommendation.title: Adopt title and refresh
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, resolve the current main conflicts, preserve `label` as the compatibility mirror, and require focused session/protocol/UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the current session label/resolve contract and recent session helper history available in this checkout.
